type A = { a: number; b: string };
type V<T> = T extends { a: number } ? T["a" | "missing"] : never;
type W<T extends A> = T["a" | "missing"];
type X<T extends { [n: number]: string }> = T[string];
type Y<T extends A> = T[number];
type Ok1<T extends A> = T["a" | "b"];
type Ok2<T extends { [n: number]: string }> = T[number];
type Ok3<T extends { [k: string]: string }> = T[number];
type Ok4<T extends string[]> = T["length" | number];
type Z<T extends A | { a: boolean }> = T["a" | "b"];
